description: 双车连续牺牲引王，后将杀
explanation_en: White sacrifices both rooks to lure the king first to g7 and then to h8, where the queen delivers checkmate.

intro.popup: 💡 引入：白车在g5和f2，白后在e4。能连续牺牲两车，把黑王引到h8再将杀吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Attraction: White's rooks are on g5 and f2, with the queen on e4. Can White sacrifice both rooks to lure the king to h8 and deliver mate?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxg7+引王到g7，Rxf7+赶王到h8，Qh7将杀！连续引入绝杀！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxg7+ draws the king to g7; Rxf7+ drives it to h8; then Qh7# delivers mate. A sequence of attractions!

moves.popup: 白车Rxg7+！第一步引诱黑王到g7。
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the rook with Rxg7+, luring the black king to g7.

moves.popup: 黑王吃车——引入第一步成功！
moves.popup_en: The black king captures the rook. The first attraction succeeds.

moves.popup: 白车再牺牲Rxf7+！把黑王赶向角落。
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the second rook with Rxf7+, driving the king toward the corner.

moves.popup: 黑王被迫退到h8——落入陷阱！
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to h8 and falls into the mating trap.

moves.popup: 白后Qh7将杀！连续引入绝杀，两车牺牲尽显引入之威！
moves.popup_en: Qh7# is checkmate! The consecutive attractions have worked, and both rook sacrifices pay off.
